definitions.sold: from rank (0.3, 0.7): the league's bottom 20% of stars traded, net, over the next 2 seasons, with future assets back
definitions.bought: the top 20% of stars traded and signed, net

definitions.present_for_future: a season in the league's bottom 20% of present value moved (stars traded and signed, net, projected over the season and the next) that came out ahead in future value (the four after)
definitions.future_for_present: the top 20% of present value moved, paid for with future value
definitions.dumped: a window that gave up as much present value with no future back and shed 10% of an average payroll
